verdict.rationale: Wise documents its own APIs for creating cards and attaching spend-control rules by merchant category code (MCC) or currency, plus toggles for channels such as e-commerce. MCC rules could approximately scope a card to a purpose like ad spend. However, the evidence never says the cards are virtual or issued instantly, and it shows no way to lock a card to a single vendor. The documentation also frames card creation as issuing to a partner's customers via API rather than a finance-lead self-serve flow in Wise Business. Missing for 10: explicit virtual card issuance, instant creation, single-merchant/vendor locking, a finance-lead UI workflow for Wise Business, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly create virtual cards scoped to a specific purpose like ad spend or a single vendor

citations.quote: With this set of APIs, you will be able to create cards for your customers.
Control which card transactions are permitted by creating rules based on merchant category code (MCC) or transaction currency.
Control spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe, etc.)
